meta.title: Táménso — AI, made practical for small and medium businesses
meta.description: Táménso helps small businesses in Italy and France put AI and Claude to work: online training by sector, a Claude assistant built for your business, and LinkedIn outreach with Waalaxy. In Italian, French and English.
nav.label: Main
hero.eyebrow: AI & automation for small businesses · Online · Italy first
hero.gloss: From the Irish “Tá mé anseo”: I am here.
hero.lede: I help small and medium businesses put AI to work: set up properly, explained in their own language, with someone beside them until it becomes a habit.
why.title: Most small businesses haven't opened this door yet. The ones that do pull ahead.
why.s1.text: of Italian companies with 10+ employees used AI in 2025, double the year before. More than eight in ten still don't.
why.s2.text: AI use among Italian SMEs versus large companies. The gap is skills and time, not size.
why.s3.text: Since February 2025, the EU AI Act asks every business using AI at work to take steps so its people understand it.
why.sources: Sources: Istat, Imprese e ICT 2025; Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), Article 4.

method.title: Here, from the first day to the day it sticks
method.m1.title: Listen
method.m1.text: An online call with you and your team to see how the work really gets done, and where it gets stuck.
method.m2.title: Build
method.m2.text: I set up the AI, the automations or your new website on what you already use, starting with one thing that saves real time.
method.m3.title: Stay
method.m3.text: I train your people, write everything down, and stay reachable. Tools change; you shouldn't have to start over.
academy.title: Learn Claude, in your language
academy.intro: The best material on AI is in English and written for developers. Táménso Academy turns it into short, free lessons for small businesses: plain language, real tasks, in Italian, French and English.
academy.c1.title: What AI can and can't do for you
academy.c1.text: A clear picture, without hype, of where it saves time and where it doesn't.
academy.c2.title: Asking well
academy.c2.text: How to brief Claude like a good colleague, with context, examples and a clear result.
academy.c3.title: Your company's knowledge, in one place
academy.c3.text: Projects, documents and instructions so answers sound like your business.
academy.c4.title: Connecting your tools
academy.c4.text: Email, calendar, shared drives and CRM, linked so the assistant can act, not just answer.
academy.c5.title: Automating a weekly task
academy.c5.text: From a repetitive job to a routine that runs on its own, step by step.
academy.c6.title: Using AI responsibly
academy.c6.text: Data, privacy, checking results, and what the AI Act asks of you.
academy.disclaimer: Built from official documentation and reputable sources, rewritten and tested for small businesses. Táménso is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic.
build.title: Follow the build
build.text: Every week: one useful thing AI can do for a small business, shown step by step, in Italian, French and English.
about.title: Eabha Cullinane
about.p1: I'm Irish and Italian, based in Paris. I build AI tools and automations for a design-and-build company, and I've seen how much time a small team gets back when the setup is done right and people are shown how to use it.
about.p2: I studied management at NOVA SBE in Lisbon and Université Paris-Dauphine. I work in English, French and Italian.
about.name: Táménso comes from the Irish “Tá mé anseo”: I am here. It's the promise behind the work: present, in your language, until it works.
contact.title: Let's start with a conversation
contact.text: Tell me what your team does each week and what takes too long. We'll start with a short online call. I reply within two working days.
sec.title: Built for your sector, or for the problem you want gone
sec.intro: No generic AI course. Each session starts from your work, so your team practises on real emails, quotes and posts.
sec.s1.d: Restaurants, cafés, bakeries and caterers: orders, suppliers, menus in several languages, reviews.
sec.s2.d: Hotels, B&Bs and guesthouses: guest messages, bookings, reviews, multilingual replies.
sec.s3.d: Studios: proposals, project briefs, client follow-up and a stronger LinkedIn presence.
sec.s4.d: Designers and makers: collection texts, press and buyer outreach, weekly social content.
sec.note: Don't see yours? Tell me what takes too long, and the session is built around it.
offer.title: Simple, and online
offer.intro: Everything happens online, so it works wherever your business is. VAT not applicable (art. 293 B CGI).
offer.o1.title: Online training session
offer.o1.text: For your team, on your sector or one problem. You leave with prompts and routines you use the next morning.
offer.o2.title: Your own Claude assistant
offer.o2.text: An assistant built for your business: your information, your tone, your recurring tasks, with a short guide on using it.
offer.o3.title: Outreach accompaniment
offer.o3.text: LinkedIn profile, Waalaxy campaigns and follow-up, month after month. Price depends on volume; ask me.
offer.pilot.title: Pilot places open.
offer.pilot.text: A few first businesses get a reduced rate in exchange for an honest case study.
offer.o4.title: Your website
offer.o4.text: A fast, beautiful site in one or more languages, with booking and contact, hosted free. Five pages in two languages: €1,800.
offer.pay: Payment: training is paid when you book. Websites: 40% to start, 40% at design approval, 20% at launch, or 3 monthly payments at no extra cost. Monthly plans are billed on the 1st.
